description: Stable public API of the TmDiagramEditor toolbar contract (DiagramEditor redesign, phase 1). The group set, the data-tm-group attribute values and both enums must survive toolbar regrouping (phase 4) unchanged — hosts and the Modeling package key off them instead of positional CSS selectors.

values.name: Full
values.description: Every toolbar group in the classic order (history, clipboard, tools, format, insert, arrange, search, panels, zoom, view, canvas-size, layout, export, templates, import, read-only). The default and the pre-split look.

values.name: Viewer
values.description: Preview-friendly subset for read-only viewer surfaces: the zoom, view, search and export groups. The read-only toggle never renders in this preset.

examples.title: Viewer toolbar for a read-only preview surface
